response.sql: WITH fee_orders_users AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.orderslink, u.acctscope FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), pair_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fee_orders_users GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope), all_pairs_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as global_mean FROM pair_averages), pairs_with_excess AS (SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, pa.avg_feerate - apm.global_mean as excess FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN all_pairs_mean apm WHERE pa.avg_feerate > apm.global_mean), ranked_pairs AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) as rank_in_scope FROM pairs_with_excess) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope FROM ranked_pairs WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope
